tasks.title: Typed API client with CSRF echo + single-flight 401 refresh retry
tasks.description: Author the hand-written typed API client at apps/ui/src/api/client.ts. The client wraps fetch with credentials:'include' so cookies (session, refresh, csrf_token) flow on every request. For UNSAFE methods (POST/PATCH/DELETE), read the `csrf_token` cookie (non-HttpOnly) and echo it as the `X-CSRF-Token` request header. Parse JSON responses via Zod schemas from @medbridge/contracts and throw a typed `ApiError` (apps/ui/src/api/errors.ts) carrying { code, message, status, details? } for non-2xx responses. Target the existing plain paths: `/api/login`, `/api/refresh`, `/api/logout`, `/api/me` (NOT the future `/api/auth.<verb>` shape; that rename is deferred per acceptance bullet 8). Implement single-flight 401 refresh: when ANY non-auth request returns 401, the client awaits a module-level shared `refreshPromise` (creating it via `POST /api/refresh` only when none is in flight); concurrent 401s coalesce onto the same promise. On refresh success, every waiter replays its original request exactly once. On refresh failure (any non-2xx), every waiter rejects with the original 401 ApiError and the shared promise is cleared. The auth endpoints (`/api/login`, `/api/refresh`, `/api/logout`) themselves are exempt from the refresh-on-401 retry to avoid loops. Author apps/ui/src/api/auth.ts which builds the typed wrappers: `api.login(body)`, `api.refresh()`, `api.logout()`, `api.me()` — each returns the Zod-parsed contract type (LoginResponse, RefreshResponse, LogoutResponse, MeResponse).
context: Brief acceptance bullets 6, 8, 10 (single-flight retry, plain /api paths, exactly one refresh on concurrent 401s)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4 (Auth model: cookies httpOnly + secure, csrf_token readable by JS, X-CSRF-Token header, double-submit)
.planning/intel/conventions.md (Auth & security invariants — csrf_token NOT HttpOnly so browser JS can read it)

tasks.title: Auth query + mutation hooks (useMe, useLogin, useLogout) backed by TanStack Query
tasks.description: Expose the typed API client through TanStack Query hooks so components never read auth state from any other source. Create apps/ui/src/api/queries/me.ts exporting `useMe()` as `useQuery({ queryKey: ['auth','me'], queryFn: api.me })` and a static `meQueryOptions` factory (also keyed `['auth','me']`) so the protected-layout's `beforeLoad` can call `queryClient.ensureQueryData(meQueryOptions)` without duplicating the key. Create apps/ui/src/api/mutations/login.ts exporting `useLogin()` as `useMutation({ mutationFn: api.login, onSuccess: (data) => queryClient.setQueryData(['auth','me'], { user: data.user }) })`. Create apps/ui/src/api/mutations/logout.ts exporting `useLogout()` as `useMutation({ mutationFn: api.logout, onSettled: () => { queryClient.setQueryData(['auth','me'], null); queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['auth','me'] }); } })` — note `onSettled` (not `onSuccess`) so cache clears whether logout resolves or rejects per acceptance bullet 13. No React Context, no Zustand, no module-level mutable auth singleton: the only source of truth is the TanStack Query cache keyed `['auth','me']`.
context: Brief acceptance bullets 3, 7, 9, 13 (login → /api/me succeeds; logout clears state; auth state via useMe only; logout optimistic invalidate)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (TanStack Query for state)
Brief clarification: 'TanStack Query cache only — read the meResponse via useQuery wherever needed, no separate context.'

tasks.title: nginx static container + docker-compose ui service
tasks.description: Containerise the apps/ui Vite build behind nginx so `docker compose up ui` serves the SPA. Create apps/ui/Dockerfile as a two-stage build: stage 1 uses node:25-slim, enables corepack, copies pnpm-lock.yaml + pnpm-workspace.yaml + root package.json + apps/ui/package.json + packages/contracts/package.json, runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then copies the repo and runs `pnpm --filter @medbridge/ui run build` to emit apps/ui/dist. Stage 2 uses nginx:alpine, copies the built bundle to /usr/share/nginx/html, copies apps/ui/nginx.conf to /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf, and exposes port 80. Create apps/ui/nginx.conf with: `root /usr/share/nginx/html;`, `index index.html;`, a `try_files $uri /index.html;` fallback (SPA history fallback), gzip on, and a `/api/` location block that `proxy_pass`es to `http://api:3000/api/` so the container can reach the API service over docker's internal DNS. Update docker-compose.yml to add a `ui` service: `build: { context: ., dockerfile: apps/ui/Dockerfile }`, `image: medbridge/ui:dev`, `ports: ['${UI_PORT:-8080}:80']`, `depends_on: { api: { condition: service_healthy } }`, `restart: unless-stopped`. Update .env.example to document `UI_PORT=8080`.
context: Brief acceptance bullet 1 (pnpm -r build emits apps/ui/dist; docker compose up ui serves index.html via nginx)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (single-host docker compose stack, static SPA served by nginx)

tasks.title: Login route + accessible email/password form (RHF + Zod + post-login redirect)
tasks.description: Create the /login route as a public TanStack Router file route at apps/ui/src/routes/login.tsx. Declare a Zod `validateSearch` schema for the `redirect` search param (optional string; same-origin path only — reject absolute URLs and protocol-relative `//...` forms; URL-decode before validation). The route component renders apps/ui/src/features/login/LoginForm.tsx. LoginForm uses react-hook-form with `zodResolver(loginRequest)` from @medbridge/contracts. Render Shadcn Form components (FormField/FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormMessage) for email and password fields — every input gets a programmatic <label> and the Shadcn primitives provide the visible focus ring (per acceptance bullet 2). On submit, call `useLogin()`; on success, read the validated `redirect` search param via `Route.useSearch()` (or `useSearch({ from: '/login' })`), and call `router.navigate({ to: redirect ?? '/dashboard' })`. On error, render an inline error region: <Alert variant='destructive' role='alert'>...</Alert> displaying the ApiError message (e.g. 'Invalid credentials' for 401); do NOT navigate away. The form must remain submittable again after error.
context: Brief acceptance bullets 2, 3, 4, 12 (accessible form, valid login → /dashboard, invalid login → role='alert' inline error, redirect search param)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (RHF + Zod resolver against packages/contracts)
Clarification: 'Encode it as /login?redirect=<encoded path> and navigate there post-login, falling back to /dashboard.'

tasks.title: Protected layout route (beforeLoad ensureQueryData) + dashboard placeholder + logout button
tasks.description: Create the __protected layout route at apps/ui/src/routes/__protected.tsx. The route exports `createFileRoute('/_protected')` (or '/__protected' depending on file-router convention — match the file name per acceptance bullet 11) with a `beforeLoad: async ({ location, context: { queryClient } }) => { try { await queryClient.ensureQueryData(meQueryOptions); } catch (err) { if (isApiError(err) && err.status === 401) { throw redirect({ to: '/login', search: { redirect: location.pathname + location.search } }); } throw err; } }`. The router context must expose queryClient — wire it via `createRouter({ ..., context: { queryClient } })` (update apps/ui/src/router.ts via may_also_touch). The component renders <Outlet />. Create apps/ui/src/routes/__protected/dashboard.tsx as a minimal placeholder (heading 'Dashboard', the LogoutButton component, no real content — Dashboard is populated in the role-aware-dashboards sprint per Out of scope). Create apps/ui/src/features/auth/LogoutButton.tsx as a button that calls `useLogout().mutate(undefined)` and, regardless of mutation outcome, calls `router.navigate({ to: '/login' })` (the navigation is unconditional per acceptance bullet 13). Errors during /api/logout are logged via console.error, never surfaced to the user.
context: Brief acceptance bullets 5, 7, 11, 13 (visiting /dashboard without session → /login; logout button issues /api/logout; __protected layout with beforeLoad + ensureQueryData + throw redirect; logout optimistic invalidate + navigate regardless)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (TanStack Router guards)
Clarification: 'beforeLoad on a __protected layout route that throws redirect({ to: "/login" }) when the auth context is missing.'
